BENILLA_MARK_ICON_BASE = 64 BENILLA_MARK_ICONS = { [64] = "Interface\\GossipFrame\\AvailableQuestIcon", [65] = "Interface\\GossipFrame\\ActiveQuestIcon", [66] = "Interface\\GossipFrame\\TrainerGossipIcon", [67] = "Interface\\GossipFrame\\VendorGossipIcon", [68] = "Interface\\GossipFrame\\BinderGossipIcon", [69] = "Interface\\GossipFrame\\TaxiGossipIcon", -- A dungeon door has no stock 1.12 icon; the skeleton key stands for the way in. [70] = "Interface\\Icons\\INV_Misc_Key_03", }
-- The landmark index of a pool frame, from its name `WorldMapFramePOI<i>`. local function BenillaMark_Index(poi) local _, _, index = string.find(poi:GetName() or "", "^WorldMapFramePOI(%d+)$") return tonumber(index) end
local function BenillaMark_TextureIndex(poi) local index = BenillaMark_Index(poi) if not index then return nil end local _, _, textureIndex = GetMapLandmarkInfo(index) return textureIndex end
local BenillaMark_OldUpdate = WorldMapFrame_Update function WorldMapFrame_Update() BenillaMark_OldUpdate() for i = 1, GetNumMapLandmarks() do local poi = getglobal("WorldMapFramePOI" .. i) local texture = getglobal("WorldMapFramePOI" .. i .. "Texture") if poi and texture then local _, _, textureIndex = GetMapLandmarkInfo(i) if textureIndex and textureIndex >= BENILLA_MARK_ICON_BASE then texture:SetTexture(BENILLA_MARK_ICONS[textureIndex] or "Interface\\Minimap\\POIIcons") texture:SetTexCoord(0, 1, 0, 1) poi:SetFrameLevel(WorldMapButton:GetFrameLevel() + 2) poi.benillaMark = true elseif poi.benillaMark then -- The pool reuses frames; the stock update already reset the tex coords. texture:SetTexture("Interface\\Minimap\\POIIcons") poi:SetFrameLevel(WorldMapButton:GetFrameLevel() + 1) poi.benillaMark = nil end end end end
local BenillaMark_OldEnter = WorldMapPOI_OnEnter function WorldMapPOI_OnEnter() local textureIndex = BenillaMark_TextureIndex(this) if not textureIndex or textureIndex < BENILLA_MARK_ICON_BASE then return BenillaMark_OldEnter() end WorldMapTooltip:SetOwner(this, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") WorldMapTooltip:SetText(this.name or "") local description = this.description if description and description ~= "" then for line in string.gfind(description, "[^\n]+") do WorldMapTooltip:AddLine(line, 1, 1, 1, 1) end end WorldMapTooltip:Show() end
local BenillaMark_OldLeave = WorldMapPOI_OnLeave function WorldMapPOI_OnLeave() local textureIndex = BenillaMark_TextureIndex(this) if not textureIndex or textureIndex < BENILLA_MARK_ICON_BASE then return BenillaMark_OldLeave() end WorldMapTooltip:Hide() end
